Intel (INTC) vs NVIDIA (NVDA): on the same formula, their operating margins are 64.6 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — INTC: $52.9B · NVDA: $215.9B
• Revenue growth — INTC: −0.5% · NVDA: +65.5%
• Operating margin — INTC: −4.2% · NVDA: 60.4%
• Net margin — INTC: −0.5% · NVDA: 55.6%
• Free cash flow margin — INTC: −9.4% · NVDA: 44.8%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — INTC: −9.6% · NVDA: 68.3%

Different fiscal years: INTC Dec 27, 2025 · NVDA Jan 25, 2026. The periods are not identical.
